'''Lianne Forget''' is the [[West Coast Talk Radio|WCTR]] news anchor in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. It is hinted that Lianne is romantically involved with [[Richard Burns]], a news reporter for WCTR, although on numerous occasions cuts him off to stop him incriminating himself. Burns later moves to [[Liberty City in GTA III Era|Liberty City]], although makes no reference to Lianne. Lianne was voiced by [[Sharon Washington]]. Her name is a pun on the phrase "lie and forget", although it is pronounced "lee-ann for-jhay".

Sharon Washington also voiced the news reporter for [[LCN]] in [[Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories]], who would report breaking news on any radio station after major events in the storyline. However, the name of the reporter is never mentioned in the game, so one can only assume it is the same character.
